entries.title: Jeremiah 15:1
segments: ¶Then the LORD said to me, "[Even] if Moses and Samuel stood before Me, My mind [would] not [be] favorable toward this people. Cast [them] out of My sight, and let them go forth.

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:2
segments: "And it shall be, if they say to you, 'Where should we go?' then you shall tell them, 'Thus says the LORD: "Such as [are] for death, to death; And such as [are] for the sword, to the sword; And such as [are] for the famine, to the famine; And such as [are] for the captivity, to the captivity."'

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:3
segments: "And I will appoint over them four forms [of destruction]," says the LORD: "the sword to slay, the dogs to drag, the birds of the heavens and the beasts of the earth to devour and destroy.

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:4
segments: "I will hand them over to trouble, to all kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh the son of Hezekiah, king of Judah, for what he did in Jerusalem.

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:5
segments: "For who will have pity on you, O Jerusalem? Or who will bemoan you? Or who will turn aside to ask how you are doing?

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:6
segments: You have forsaken Me," says the LORD, "You have gone backward. Therefore I will stretch out My hand against you and destroy you; I am weary of relenting!

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:7
segments: And I will winnow them with a winnowing fan in the gates of the land; I will bereave [them] of children; I will destroy My people, [Since] they do not return from their ways.

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:8
segments: Their widows will be increased to Me more than the sand of the seas; I will bring against them, Against the mother of the young men, A plunderer at noonday; I will cause anguish and terror to fall on them suddenly.

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:9
segments: "She languishes who has borne seven; She has breathed her last; Her sun has gone down While [it was] yet day; She has been ashamed and confounded. And the remnant of them I will deliver to the sword Before their enemies," says the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:10
segments: ¶Woe is me, my mother, That you have borne me, A man of strife and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have neither lent for interest, Nor have men lent to me for interest. Every one of them curses me.

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:11
segments: The LORD said: "Surely it will be well with your remnant; Surely I will cause the enemy to intercede with you In the time of adversity and in the time of affliction.

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:12
segments: Can anyone break iron, The northern iron and the bronze?

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:13
segments: Your wealth and your treasures I will give as plunder without price, Because of all your sins, Throughout your territories.

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:14
segments: And I will make [you] cross over with your enemies Into a land [which] you do not know; For a fire is kindled in My anger, [Which] shall burn upon you."

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:15
segments: ¶O LORD, You know; Remember me and visit me, And take vengeance for me on my persecutors. In Your enduring patience, do not take me away. Know that for Your sake I have suffered rebuke.

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:16
segments: Your words were found, and I ate them, And Your word was to me the joy and rejoicing of my heart; For I am called by Your name, O LORD God of hosts.

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:17
segments: I did not sit in the assembly of the mockers, Nor did I rejoice; I sat alone because of Your hand, For You have filled me with indignation.

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:18
segments: Why is my pain perpetual And my wound incurable, [Which] refuses to be healed? Will You surely be to me like an unreliable stream, [As] waters [that] fail?

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:19
segments: Therefore thus says the LORD: "If you return, Then I will bring you back; You shall stand before Me; If you take out the precious from the vile, You shall be as My mouth. Let them return to you, But you must not return to them.

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:20
segments: And I will make you to this people a fortified bronze wall; And they will fight against you, But they shall not prevail against you; For I [am] with you to save you And deliver you," says the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:21
segments: "I will deliver you from the hand of the wicked, And I will redeem you from the grip of the terrible."
